_comment: Green bottle glass: soda-lime glass tinted green by iron and chromium oxides. TranslucentThin: a bottle wall is a thin shell seen through, the same master as Glass_Clear. The green is transmission_color, authored here, because the Creator tint does not reach what is seen through glass (E2), so a see-through colour is its own article. Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): scratches (overlay 1, damage), dust, fingerprints, gated by the Grime mask. Water spots would be a fourth; per C3 that is a sibling article.
name: Glass_Green_Clean_Base_s01_v01

sources.why: transmission_color 0.35, 0.70, 0.30: a typical green beverage-bottle tint; Physically Based lists only clear soda-lime.
